---
title: "Section child"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['#quarto-sidebar a.sidebar-link.active[href="./section-child.html"][aria-current="page"]']
        - ['#quarto-sidebar a[href="./section.html"][aria-current]',
           '#quarto-sidebar a.sidebar-link:not(.active)[aria-current]']
---

The parent section of the current page is expanded but is not the current
page, so its link has no `aria-current`.
